cells.name: Observatory Status Timeline (Horizontal Blue Line indicates Operational)

queries.query:
import "array"

sal = float(v: v.salIndex)

// --- real status series (works for relative + absolute time ranges) ---
status =
  from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "lsst.sal.Scheduler.logevent_observatoryStatus" and
      (r._field == "status" or r._field == "salIndex")
    )
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.salIndex and exists r.status)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.salIndex == sal)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "status"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: float(v: r.status),
      _field: "status",
      _measurement: "observatoryStatus",
    }))
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])

// --- compute real data span (first/last time) ---
spanStart =
  status
    |> group(columns: [])            // collapse any stray group keys
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> first()
    |> keep(columns: ["_time"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, k: 1}))
    |> group(columns: ["k"])

spanStop =
  status
    |> group(columns: [])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> last()
    |> keep(columns: ["_time"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, k: 1}))
    |> group(columns: ["k"])

span =
  union(tables: [spanStart, spanStop])
    |> group(columns: ["k"])

// --- enum definitions ---
enums =
  array.from(rows: [
    {k: 1, label: "OPERATIONAL", val: 2.0},
  ])
  |> group(columns: ["k"])

// --- cross-join span x enums => 2 points per enum line ---
refs =
  join(tables: {t: span, e: enums}, on: ["k"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: r.val,
      _field: r.label,
      _measurement: "observatoryStatus",
    }))
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])

// --- overlay ---
union(tables: [status, refs])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> yield(name: "status_with_enum_lines")

queries.query: SELECT "statusLabels", "status", "salIndex" FROM "efd"."autogen"."lsst.sal.Scheduler.logevent_observatoryStatus" WHERE salIndex = :salIndex: AND  time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
